texts.zh:
在住宅区中部拆除非承重墙时，装修工人发现了一些异常情况：几十年来未经授权的改动。隐藏的房间、私自搭建的壁龛、被改造成储藏室或居住空间的封闭走廊。这些都不在原始设计图中，而且其中一些还是承重结构。

首席工程师正在请求决策。拆除所有不在原始计划中的部分是正确的做法。这将需要时间。绕过这些改动会更快，但会引入结构不规则性，这将很难向未来的工程师解释。
texts.en:
During demolition of non-load-bearing walls in the mid-residential sections, the renovation crews have discovered something unusual: decades of unauthorized modifications. Hidden rooms, self-constructed alcoves, sealed corridors repurposed as storage or living space. None of it is in the original schematics, and some of it is load-bearing.

The lead engineer is requesting a decision. Removing everything not in the original plans is the correct approach. It will take time. Working around the modifications is faster, but introduces structural irregularities that will be difficult to explain to future engineers.

texts.zh:
对住宅部门非结构性元素的拆解过程中，我们发现了大量未经授权的建筑改造。在多个区域发现了未经备案的隔断、通道改动和临时承重装置。这些都没有在原始设计规范中记录。

完全拆除在结构上是正确的，但耗时。文档记录和变通路线可作为替代方案。
texts.en:
Deconstruction of residential sector non-structural elements has revealed extensive unauthorized architectural modifications. Off-record partitioning, access route alterations, and improvised load-bearing installations have been identified across multiple zones. None are documented in original design specifications.

Full removal is structurally correct but time-consuming. Documentation and workaround routing is available as an alternative.

texts.zh: 拆除中层居住区的内墙后，我们发现了数代未经授权的殖民地改造。隐蔽的洞穴、自行挖掘的通道、改作巢穴的密封空间，所有这些都完全不在飞船的正式结构中。其中一些是承重结构。正确移除是正确的做法，但耗时。绕开它们更快，但会引入结构不规则性，这将给未来的巢穴管理员带来麻烦。
texts.en: Demolition of interior walls in the mid-residential sections has uncovered generations of unauthorized colony modification. Hidden burrows, self-bored access tunnels, sealed chambers repurposed as nesting alcoves, and each entirely absent from the vessel's formal structure. Some are load-bearing. Proper removal is the correct approach but time-consuming. Working around them is faster, but introduces structural irregularities that will trouble future nest-wardens.

label.zh: 能记录的记录下来。剩下的想办法解决。
label.en: Document what we can. Work around the rest.

label.zh: 移除所有不符合原始规划的内容。
label.en: Remove everything not in the original specifications.
